high_xy_physical_cloth_separation.conclusion: All four high XY translations fail the 5mm teddy-left gate while still at least52mm above the entire physical bag body. The limiting obstacle is the held left hand, before any body/sewn-corner contact can occur in this frozen hypothesis. Handles are excluded from this body-only bound; actual transport already had front-handle proximity.

bounded_search_conclusion: No candidate is admissible: all four independent high XY segments fail the unchanged5mm whole-teddy/left-hand continuous sweep gate. All tested robot paths retain at least14.9mm sampled rigid clearance. No search expansion or physical motion is authorized by this diagnostic.
unperformed_due_to_high_xy_rejection: No detailed cloth-contact sweep of unreachable descent hypotheses. The high-XY whole-body separating-axis bound already establishes that left-hand geometry blocks the attempted early alignment before physical bag-body contact.
